const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path');
const {pathToFileURL}=require('node:url');
const {chromium}=require('C:/Users/maco/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/node_modules/playwright');
process.chdir(path.resolve(__dirname,'..'));
const out='dist/v005-audio-stability';
(async()=>{
 const browser=await chromium.launch({executablePath:'C:/Program Files (x86)/Microsoft/Edge/Application/msedge.exe',headless:true});const results=[];
 try{for(const file of ['jsnes-lite.readable.html','jsnes-lite.min.html'])for(const open of [false,true]){
  const context=await browser.newContext({offline:true});const page=await context.newPage();const errors=[];
  page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message));
  await page.goto(pathToFileURL(path.resolve(out,file)).href);await page.locator('#i_start').uncheck();
  await page.evaluate(open=>{document.getElementById('p_debug').open=open},open);
  await page.locator('#fileInput').setInputFiles(process.env.FIELD_COMBAT_ROM||'upstream/roms/croom/croom.nes');
  await page.waitForFunction(()=>document.getElementById('loadStatus').textContent.includes('loaded'));
  const images=await page.evaluate(()=>{
   for(let i=0;i<120;i++)document.getElementById('b_frame').click();
   const hash=data=>{let h=2166136261;for(const b of data)h=Math.imul(h^b,16777619);return h>>>0};
   const frame=document.getElementById('frameCanvas'),vram=document.getElementById('vramCanvas');
   const image=vram.getContext('2d').getImageData(0,0,vram.width,vram.height).data;
   return{frame:hash(frame.getContext('2d').getImageData(0,0,256,240).data),vramNonzero:image.some(v=>v!==0)};
  });
  results.push({file,open,errors,...images});console.log(results.at(-1));await context.close();
 }}finally{await browser.close()}
 fs.writeFileSync(out+'/verification-vram.json',JSON.stringify(results,null,2)+'\n');
 if(results.some(r=>r.errors.length||r.vramNonzero!==r.open||r.frame!==results[0].frame))process.exitCode=1;
})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exitCode=1});
